modules.module_title: Perform swab checks for hygiene monitoring

pcs.pc_description: use sterile swabs and equipment to collect samples from designated areas, such as hands, air, and equipment, according to standard procedures
transfer swabs into test tubes containing sterile buffered peptone water or appropriate diluent without contamination
ensure that the sample collection is conducted under appropriate lighting and environmental conditions
shake the test tube gently and allow it to stand as per specified protocols to release microorganisms into the solution
remove the swab and analyze the sample as per laboratory specifications and standard operating procedures (SOPs)

modules.module_title: Process microbiological samples and perform microscopy

pcs.pc_description: apply correct disinfection procedures to work areas before and after handling samples to prevent cross-contamination
prepare and stain thin smears and liquid films of samples for microscopic examination
set up and calibrate microscopes, ensuring proper magnification and resolution for accurate observation of microorganisms
examine dry, wet, and stained specimens to identify microbial structures and characteristics
maintain, clean, and store microscopes and related equipment as per standard protocols
prepare and use culture media, agar plates, and broth as per laboratory requirements
apply aseptic techniques to streak samples on agar plates to isolate single colonies of microorganisms
select appropriate incubation conditions, such as temperature and gaseous environment, to support the growth of specific microorganisms
perform serial dilutions of samples accurately to determine microbial load
monitor and record bacterial growth, estimating colony-forming units (CFU) as required by testing protocols

modules.module_title: Perform microbiological tests and interpret results

pcs.pc_description: conduct biochemical and serological tests on pure cultures to identify specific microorganisms
conduct TPC tests to quantify total microbial load, ensuring accurate plating and incubation for total microbial load determination
conduct yeast and mould tests, ensuring the use of selective media and incubation conditions appropriate for fungal growth detection
interpret the results of yeast and mould tests in line with standard limits for acceptable fungal contamination
prepare enrichment media for salmonella testing
conduct salmonella detection using biochemical or serological methods as per laboratory protocols for proper detection and identification
prepare and use stained slides to observe morphological features of bacteria and other microbes
compare test results with standard parameters and critical limits, identifying any deviations or anomalies
document and communicate test results and deviations to the relevant authorities as per organizational procedures

modules.module_title: Perform advanced microbiological tests and interpret results

pcs.pc_description: perform Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) to detect specific antigens or antibodies in food samples, ensuring accuracy and compliance with test protocols
conduct Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) for the detection and identification of DNA from pathogenic and non-pathogenic organisms in food samples
use Real-Time PCR (qPCR) for quantitative analysis of microbial load in food products
validate test results by comparing with standard controls and report any deviations
differentiate between pathogens (e.g., Salmonella, E. coli) and non-pathogens (e.g., Lactobacillus) using biochemical and molecular techniques
document and report test findings, including interpretations and implications for food safety

modules.module_title: Apply appropriate techniques to cultivate and isolate microorganisms

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate media and incubation conditions for culturing both pathogenic and non- pathogenic microorganisms
implement selective and differential media for distinguishing between microbial groups
perform colony counting and morphological identification of cultured pathogens and non- pathogens

modules.module_title: Adhere to laboratory safety and quality standards

pcs.pc_description: follow laboratory safety guidelines, using personal protective equipment (PPE) and biosafety protocols
implement quality control measures to ensure the accuracy and precision of microbiological test results
record and report all test data in compliance with laboratory quality management systems
dispose of samples, media, and biohazardous waste according to established safety procedures
